_note: Public qsme.build pages only, no login, nothing typed. Element crops so nothing else on the page is in frame (never the /platform AI module, which says 'summarise bids'). 2026-10-04: card-award trims its second sentence ('You can award to a firm without an account; ... when they sign up.') before the crop, because the owner CTA rule bans 'without an account' on screen.

shots.name: card-award
shots.hl: No automation and no assistant awards a tender.
shots.prep: (() => { const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('li.card')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Award is a person')); if (!card) return 'NO CARD'; const tw = document.createTreeWalker(card, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let n, cut = 0; while ((n = tw.nextNode())) { const i = n.textContent.indexOf('You can award to a firm'); if (i >= 0) { n.textContent = n.textContent.slice(0, i).replace(/\s+$/, ''); cut++; let x = n.nextSibling; while (x) { const nx = x.nextSibling; x.remove(); x = nx; } } } card.style.setProperty('height','auto','important'); card.style.setProperty('min-height','0','important'); card.style.setProperty('align-self','start','important'); return { cut, h: card.getBoundingClientRect().height, text: card.innerText }; })()

shots.name: demo-what-happens
shots.el: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('What happens on a demo')); if (!h) return null; const li = [...h.nextElementSibling.querySelectorAll('li')]; return [h, li[0], li[1]]; })()
